summary: Tested Bug 1 (DC creation material shortage popup) and Bug 2 (SC dialog processed child) fixes. Bug 1 is FULLY VERIFIED via backend tests and frontend UI. Bug 2 code implementation is VERIFIED CORRECT via code review - the hasProcessedChild computed property correctly checks for completed/in_progress children and disables 'Without Material' option with appropriate message.
passed_tests: Bug 1 Backend: POST /api/job-work/challans returns ALL insufficient items when stock is short (3/3 tests passed)
Bug 1 Backend: Response format matches expected: {success: false, message, insufficient_materials: [{item, name, required, available, shortage}]}
Bug 1 Frontend: DC creation dialog shows full shortage list with part numbers, names, required, available, and shortage values
Bug 1 Frontend: Verified with TEST-SHORT items - all 3 items shown in shortage dialog
Bug 2 Code Review: hasProcessedChild computed property correctly checks descendants for completed/in_progress status
Bug 2 Code Review: SC dialog 'Without Material' label has opacity-40 and cursor-not-allowed classes when hasProcessedChild is true
Bug 2 Code Review: SC dialog 'Without Material' radio input has disabled={hasProcessedChild}
Bug 2 Code Review: SC dialog shows 'Not available — child items already processed' message when hasProcessedChild is true
Regression: DC creation succeeds when stock is sufficient
critical_code_review_comments: Bug 1 Backend (server.py lines 5899-5920): First pass correctly checks ALL items for stock availability before raising error, returns full insufficient_materials list - VERIFIED WORKING
Bug 1 Frontend (JobWorkPage.js lines 134-136): handleCreateDC correctly handles {success: false, insufficient_materials} response and shows dcSendResult dialog - VERIFIED WORKING
Bug 2 Frontend (ManufacturingPage.js lines 342-353): hasProcessedChild correctly uses recursive checkDescendants to find completed/in_progress children - VERIFIED CORRECT
Bug 2 Frontend (ManufacturingPage.js lines 1932-1936): SC dialog 'Without Material' option correctly disabled with message when hasProcessedChild is true - VERIFIED CORRECT

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Bug 1 UI verified, Bug 2 code review verified)

seed_data_creation: Test items (TEST-SHORT-*, TEST-PARTIAL-*, TEST-SUFFICIENT-*), suppliers, and SC orders created during backend testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
